title.title: Lotus for Windows
title.tag: A start screen and command center for PowerShell 7 · beta
title.small: One real run on GitHub's Windows machine – cut only for time
title.say: This is Lotus for Windows. A start screen and command center, for PowerShell 7.

end.title: Lotus for Windows
end.tag: beta · PowerShell 7 · no administrator rights · no WSL
end.small:
fanxy13.github.io/homebrew-lotus

Recorded in one run on GitHub's Windows machine (Windows Server 2025) · only time is cut

end.say: Lotus for Windows. Free, open source, and one line away.

scenes.name: install
scenes.title: Install in one line
scenes.sub: the line from the website, in PowerShell 7
scenes.say: Installing it takes one line, pasted from the website. No admin rights needed. It even sets up fastfetch for you.

scenes.name: setup
scenes.title: A minute of setup
scenes.sub: it starts by itself after the install
scenes.say: Then a quick setup starts on its own. Your language, your name, a theme. And a pet.

scenes.name: start
scenes.title: Every window starts here
scenes.sub: a new PowerShell window – the greeting and your PC
scenes.say: From now on, every new window greets you, with your PC at a glance.

scenes.name: weather
scenes.title: The weather, right there
scenes.say: Slash commands work right in PowerShell. Like the weather.

scenes.name: pet
scenes.title: A pet that talks
scenes.sub: mochi – the AI on this PC answers: Ollama, qwen2.5:3b
scenes.say: This is Mochi. It lives in your terminal, and chats with you through an AI that runs right on this PC.

scenes.name: ai
scenes.title: Ask the AI
scenes.sub: /ai – here with Ollama, on the PC's own processor
scenes.say: Ask the AI anything with slash A-I. Here, it is Ollama, running locally.

scenes.name: ai-command
scenes.title: A command – never run for you
scenes.sub: /ai command – it goes on your command line, you press Enter
scenes.say: Or let it write a command for you. Lotus puts it on your command line, and never runs it on its own.

scenes.name: catalog
scenes.title: Apps from winget
scenes.sub: /install – 61 apps in categories, the exact command first
scenes.say: Browse sixty-one apps by category, and install them with win-get.

scenes.name: brew
scenes.title: Search and install
scenes.sub: /brew ripgrep – all of winget, installed in the open
scenes.say: Or search all of win-get. Rip-grep installs in seconds, right in the open.

scenes.name: app
scenes.title: Open apps by name
scenes.say: Open any app by name. Typos included.

scenes.name: img
scenes.title: Photos, much smaller
scenes.sub: /img convert – five photos to WebP, with ImageMagick
scenes.say: Convert a whole folder of photos to Web P. Much smaller files, in one go.

scenes.name: convert
scenes.title: A video, saved as MP3
scenes.say: Save the sound of a video you have the rights to, as an MP3.

scenes.name: live
scenes.title: Live Server
scenes.sub: /liveserver – the page reloads when you save
scenes.say: Building a website? Live Server reloads the page every time you save.

scenes.name: html
scenes.title: Web pages as documents
scenes.say: And turn a web page into a PDF, a Word file, or Markdown.

scenes.name: caffeine
scenes.title: Keep the PC awake
scenes.sub: /caffeine – for a download, a render, a server
scenes.say: Keep your PC awake for an hour, for a big download.

scenes.name: clock
scenes.title: A clock, six ways
scenes.say: A full screen clock, in six designs.

scenes.name: zetamac
scenes.title: A math game that feeds the pets
scenes.sub: /zetamac – every right answer is a bite for Mochi
scenes.say: A quick math game. Every right answer feeds your pet.

scenes.name: settings
scenes.title: Everything in /settings
scenes.sub: the theme and the prompt change as you choose
scenes.say: Every setting lives in one place, and changes as you go.

scenes.name: doctor
scenes.title: lotus doctor
scenes.sub: what Lotus finds on this PC
scenes.say: And lotus doctor checks it all.
